description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd level spells, Elemental Focus (Lightning)

Benefit: As long as you have an elemental (lightning) spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can fire a 20-foot line of lightning as a standard action, dealing 1d6 points of lightning damage per level of the highest-level lightning spell you can cast. A successful Reflex save halves damage. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (lightning) spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 3rd level spells, Elemental Focus (Lightning)
